sentences.en: When is the final exam?
I need to study for the test tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我需要為明天的考試讀書。

sentences.en: I hope I pass the exam.
I'm afraid I might fail this test.
sentences.zh: 我擔心這次考試會不及格。

sentences.en: What score did you get?
I got a good grade on the midterm.
We need to review all the chapters.
sentences.zh: 我們需要複習所有章節。

sentences.en: The exam covers chapters one through five.
sentences.zh: 考試範圍是第一章到第五章。

sentences.en: Is it an open-book exam?
There will be multiple-choice questions.
I'm so nervous about the exam.
How much time do we have for the test?
Please put away your phones during the exam.
sentences.zh: 考試時請把手機收起來。

sentences.en: I didn't have enough time to finish.
sentences.zh: 我沒有足夠的時間完成。

sentences.en: The passing score is 60 percent.
Can I retake the exam?
I studied all night for this test.
sentences.zh: 我為了這次考試熬夜讀書。

sentences.en: The results will be posted next week.
This question is worth ten points.
I need to improve my grade.
The exam was harder than I expected.
Don't forget to write your name on the exam paper.
sentences.zh: 別忘了在考卷上寫名字。

sentences.en: I got full marks on the quiz.
We have a pop quiz today.
Please read the questions carefully.
I blanked out during the exam.
sentences.zh: 我考試時腦袋一片空白。

sentences.en: The teacher graded our papers already.
sentences.zh: 老師已經改好我們的考卷了。

sentences.en: I made some careless mistakes on the test.
sentences.zh: 我在考試中犯了一些粗心的錯誤。

sentences.en: Let's go over the answers together.
I'll do better on the next exam.
sentences.zh: 我下次考試會考得更好。
